name: ad5940lib
description: AD5940 SDK fork — adds AD5940_RAM_FN(name) macro for SRAM-residency of Core1 hot path; fixes AD5940_SEQGpioTrigCfg, which never wrote EI1CON and so could not enable a sequencer GPIO trigger on AGPIO4..7. Vendor at https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/ad5940lib (commit 818c548).
